messages.content: Build a small web app: index.html with a heading Counter and a button, styles.css styling it black and gold, app.js wiring the button click to increment a counter shown on the page. Also add utils.js exporting function add(a,b) and utils.test.js that prints PASS when add(2,3) equals 5.
Change the counter to start at 10 instead of 0, and make the button text read Clicked N times after each click. Update only the files that need to change.
Read the attached notes and add the tagline from them as a footer paragraph in index.html.
Add a reset button next to the counter that sets the count back to 10.
